content:
Although there are rumors that the iPhone 18 Pro will start at US$1,399, this claim may be exaggerated; however, a significant price hike for this year's new series is almost unavoidable.

Apple has already laid the groundwork for the price hike through its new Apple Upgrade program, and T-Mobile has responded immediately by launching a new three-year installment plan...

In June this year, facing soaring memory costs, Apple raised prices for most of its products. Existing iPhone models were not affected at the time, but it is certain that the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max will be priced higher than last year's equivalent models.

The Apple Upgrade leasing plan allows users to enjoy various Apple products, including the iPhone, at a lower monthly fee. However, the biggest trap is that users do not own the product after the payment period ends, which could lead many customers into an endless cycle of Apple Upgrade leasing.

T-Mobile will launch a new installment plan tomorrow, allowing customers to spread the cost of the iPhone and all related fees over three years instead of the previous two. The plan, called EIP Flex 36, is marketed with zero interest and zero down payment as its selling points.

It is worth noting that both offers come with conditions: zero down payment and zero interest only apply to customers with good credit ratings. The terms also state that some customers may face an APR of up to 24%. However, if you qualify and plan to keep the phone for three years or more, the plan is still quite attractive.
